crossRefs.note: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
“I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
crossRefs.keyword: weights. Heb. stones. I am. See on

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
translations.bsb: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
translations.kjv: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
translations.asv: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
